verdict.rationale: Working Copy explicitly integrates with the iOS Files app and other apps' sandboxes: repositories appear in the Files app/document picker for 3rd party apps, external directories/document packages from other apps can be linked, files can be dragged in from email/other apps, and a built-in WebDAV server plus Shortcuts automation enable cross-app file flow. This directly matches accessing/working with files and repos across app sandboxes on-device. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of cross-app sandbox access beyond vendor docs.
